newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical to redeem preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical to redeem preferred stock.

text.p: Advanced Medical Inc said Monday it will redeem all 329,913 shares of its 10 percent cumulative preferred stock that were outstanding from the March 1989 issuance.
The company said it will redeem the stock for a total of about $4.0 million to preferred shareholders of record on Oct 18.

It said the redemption was part of a settlement agreement with preferred shareholders on the basis of $10 per share plus accrued dividends calculated on a pro rata basis to the redemption date and less the $1.50 per share payment that will be paid to shareholder attorneys.
Advanced Medical Inc, through its IMED Corp subsidiary, develops and manufactures intravenous infusion pumps and proprietary disposable products.
